summary: Removed three unused CSS data-ui hooks (native-folder-picker, window-controls, window-control) left over from the Tauri removal, then began designing an included Gizmo tool that uses the json-render package to render formatted content inline in chat, spawning backend and frontend subagents to implement it.
decisions: Chose to delete the dead CSS hooks rather than reintroduce matching markup, because the corresponding components (NativeWorkspacePicker, WindowControls) were intentionally removed when Tauri was dropped (commit c071310).
Constrained the new `display` tool's catalog to a fixed set of safe renderable elements (text, headings, cards, tables, lists, metrics) and explicitly excluded arbitrary HTML or executable actions.

Split implementation across two parallel subagents: one owning the backend Pi tool, protocol types, and tool-result transport integration; the other owning the Svelte chat-side renderer that integrates with ToolResult/ToolCall.
errors: A bash command combining a multi-line pipe with `git log` exited with code 1 during exploration, but did not block progress since the prior `pnpm check:hooks` already exposed the dead hooks.
